name: Joe Biden

lean.basis: Democratic U.S. senator from Delaware (1973–2009), Democratic vice president and Democratic president.

source.title: File:Joe Biden presidential portrait.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Former President of the United States (2021–2025)
summary: Joe Biden was the 46th president of the United States from 2021 to 2025, after 36 years as a U.S. senator from Delaware and eight years as Barack Obama's vice president. He ended his 2024 reelection campaign on July 21, 2024 and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris, who lost the election to Donald Trump.

sources.title: Biden ends his 2024 presidential campaign, endorses Harris as Democratic nominee — AP via Hawaii News Now

timeline.role: 47th Vice President of the United States
Withdrew from the presidential race on July 21 and endorsed Kamala Harris

sources.title: Biden ends his 2024 presidential campaign, endorses Harris as Democratic nominee — AP via Hawaii News Now

connections.name: Barack Obama
connections.description: Biden was Obama's running mate in 2008 and his vice president for both terms; Obama campaigned for him in 2020, though in July 2024 he questioned Biden's chances.

connections.name: Kamala Harris
connections.description: Biden chose Harris as his 2020 running mate; she was his vice president from 2021 to 2025, and when he withdrew on July 21, 2024 he endorsed her within about half an hour.

sources.title: Biden ends his 2024 presidential campaign, endorses Harris as Democratic nominee — AP via Hawaii News Now

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Biden defeated Trump in the 2020 presidential election, 306–232 in the Electoral College; they were set for a rematch in 2024 until Biden withdrew.

sources.title: Biden ends his 2024 presidential campaign, endorses Harris as Democratic nominee — AP via Hawaii News Now

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: On June 4, 2025 Trump ordered an investigation into whether Biden's aides concealed his mental decline and used an autopen to sign his executive actions; Biden called it a distraction.

sources.title: Reviewing Certain Presidential Actions — The White House
Trump orders a probe into the Biden administration and its alleged autopen use — NPR
Trump orders probe of Biden aides — The Washington Times

connections.name: Pete Buttigieg
connections.description: Biden named his former primary rival Secretary of Transportation; the Senate confirmed him 86–13 on February 2, 2021, and he served to January 2025.

sources.title: Pete Buttigieg confirmed by Senate as Biden transportation secretary — CNBC
Senate votes to confirm Pete Buttigieg — PBS NewsHour

connections.name: Bernie Sanders
connections.description: Sanders was Biden's last remaining opponent in the 2020 Democratic primaries; he dropped out on April 8, 2020 and endorsed Biden.

connections.name: Jill Biden
connections.description: Wife, married 1977; first lady from 2021 to 2025.

sources.title: First Lady Dr. Jill Biden — Biden Presidential Library

connections.name: Gretchen Whitmer
connections.description: Whitmer endorsed Biden in March 2020, became a national co-chair of his campaign and was a finalist for running mate.

connections.name: Ruben Gallego
connections.description: Gallego endorsed Biden in March 2020.

connections.name: Elizabeth Warren
connections.description: Warren ran against Biden in the 2020 primaries and was one of the finalists he considered for running mate.

connections.name: Amy Klobuchar
connections.description: Klobuchar ended her 2020 campaign and endorsed Biden before Super Tuesday; she was the first speaker at his inauguration.

connections.name: Pete Aguilar
connections.description: Biden pre-emptively pardoned the January 6 select committee members, including Aguilar, in January 2025.

connections.name: Hillary Clinton
connections.description: Clinton served alongside Biden in Obama's administration and endorsed him for president in April 2020.

connections.name: Adam Schiff
connections.description: Biden pre-emptively pardoned Schiff and the other January 6 committee members in January 2025, though Schiff had urged him to quit the 2024 race.

connections.name: Jamie Raskin
connections.description: Biden pre-emptively pardoned the January 6 select committee members, including Raskin, on January 20, 2025.

connections.name: Tom Steyer
connections.description: Steyer hosted a 2023 fundraiser for Biden's re-election at his San Francisco home.

connections.name: Jen O'Malley Dillon
connections.description: O'Malley Dillon managed Biden's 2020 campaign, was his deputy chief of staff (2021–2024) and chaired his 2024 campaign.

sources.title: Biden picks for senior White House staff — CNBC
Biden's campaign manager headed to White House as deputy chief of staff — Fox News

connections.name: David Plouffe
connections.description: Worked alongside Plouffe in the Obama White House; in 2015 Plouffe reportedly helped persuade Biden not to challenge Clinton.

connections.name: Rahm Emanuel
connections.description: Biden appointed Emanuel ambassador to Japan; he served from March 2022 to January 2025.

sources.title: Ambassador Rahm Emanuel — U.S. Embassy & Consulates in Japan
Rahm Emanuel among dozens of late-night diplomatic confirmations — NPR

connections.name: Ron Klain
connections.description: Klain was his vice-presidential chief of staff (2009–2011) and his first White House chief of staff (2021–2023).

sources.title: Biden selects Ronald Klain as White House chief of staff — Fox News
Ron Klain leaving vice president's staff — The New York Times

connections.name: Gabby Giffords
connections.description: Giffords's group helped shape Biden's gun-safety agenda and endorsed his 2024 re-election; Biden awarded her the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2022.

sources.title: Giffords endorses President Biden for re-election — Giffords
Major gun safety groups come together to endorse Biden for 2024 — PBS NewsHour

connections.name: Jim Clyburn
connections.description: Clyburn endorsed Biden three days before the 2020 South Carolina primary; Biden won the state by about 30 points and credits the endorsement with reviving his campaign.

sources.title: Clyburn, credited with helping Biden win the 2020 nomination, endorses Harris — ABC News (AP)
Does Biden win South Carolina without Clyburn's endorsement? — ABC News 4

connections.name: Deb Haaland
connections.description: Biden nominated Haaland as Interior secretary; she served from March 2021 through his term.
